# dsh-vault
**English** · 中文
**Encrypted full backup and restore for DSH (DeepSeek Harness)**
> Packs **config / sessions / skills / plugins / workspaces / Hindsight memory / the DSH client inst

aller** into
> **encrypted, chunked volumes**, written to a local directory and optionally pushed to

a NAS (network share or WebDAV).
> Every package carries a **self-contained restorer** and a recove

ry ledger inside it, with GFS rotation and optional
> scheduled backups.
>
> **Zero build step · zer

o external dependencies**: the pure-ESM JavaScript under `lib/` *is* the source and the
> artifact.
Only `node:` builtins are used — no 7z, no openssl, no rclone, no npm dependency — so it installs on

any
> machine that runs DSH.
>
> Status (2026-10-17): **verified**. Real packages `core` (599 MB) a

nd `full_all` (711 MB) both pass `verify`
> (plaintext hash and per-volume hashes agree) and `restor

e-drill` (30/30, 31/31). Runs on DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`, with the
> settings panel, all six tools and the

HTTP API exercised in a real injected session. Contract **checked against
> `0.2.1-rc.2`** — see doc
s/compat-0.2.1-rc.2.md (9 contracts, 8 unchanged, 1 additive).

*Does not require**: 7z / openssl / gpg / rclone / any npm dependency. Docker is used only when back

ing up Hindsight's
Postgres database (`docker exec … pg_dump`).

## 2. Six tools (the AI-facing entry points)
| Tool | What it does | Key parameters |
| `vault_scan` | Scan and preview by importance tier (P0 must-keep / P1 optional / P2 excluded), **n

o side effects** | `scope`, `includeP1`, `topExcluded` |
| `vault_backup` | Run an encrypted backup

and write it out | `password`, `outDir`, `scope`, `includeP1`, `dryRun` |
| `vault_list` | List hist

orical packages (grouping volumes of one logical package) | `dir` |
| `vault_verify` | Full decrypt

plus plaintext/volume hash check (writes nothing) | `package` (required), `password` |
| `vault_rest
ore` | Restore: unpack to `--target`, or restore in place | `package` (required), `password`, `targe

t`, `inPlace`, `only`, `list` |
| `vault_prune` | GFS rotation (dry-run by default, prints the delet
e list) | `dir`, `apply`, `hardDelete`, `keepLast`, `maxTotalGB` |
> Tool schemas are guarded by `scripts/schema-gate.mjs`: top-level `type:'object'`, `required` a top

-level array of
> strings, and **no** boolean `required` inside property nodes. Historically an inva

lid schema made whole
> DeepSeek/mimo sessions return 400.
## 3. Scripts (the command-line entry points, all dependency-free)
[代码示例省略，未执行]
**Build**: `bash scripts/build.sh` — for a zero-build package this only runs the `node --check` synt

ax gate, the
schema gate and a required-files existence check.
## 4. Password and key policy
| Source | Priority | Notes |
| `--password <value>` | 1 | Explicit; shows up in the process command line, fine for a one-off loca

l run |
| Env var `DSHVAULT_PASSWORD` (name configurable) | 2 | Suitable for scripts and scheduled j

var `DSHVAULT_PASSWORD` (name configurable) | 2 | Suitable for scripts and scheduled jobs |
[该节后续省略]
## 5. Backup scope and exclusion rules
**Partitions**
| Partition | Contents |
| `00-installer` | The DSH client installer (the prerequisite for restoring onto a bare machine; **e

xempt from the L4 large-binary rule**) |
[该节后续省略]
## 8. Architecture (`lib/`, all dependency-free)
| Module | Responsibility |
| `index.js` | Plugin entry: registers the six tools; optionally wires the webserver route (degrades

cleanly when the service is absent) |
| `vault/paths.js` | `$DSH_HOME` / workspace discovery / inst

aller and orchestration detection |
| `vault/io.js` | Stable reads `stableStat` / walk / sha256 / at

omic writes |
| `vault/filter.js` | Four exclusion layers plus `classifyEntry` |
| `vault/importance

.js` | Scoring with P0/P1/P2 tiering |
| `vault/tar.js` | Hand-written tar (ustar + GNU LongLink); *
*reads exactly the declared size** (so entries cannot drift) plus a re-check of hot files before wri

ting |
| `vault/crypto.js` | scrypt + AES-256-GCM with 8 MiB chunked AEAD; plaintext header (magic +

len + JSON) |
| `vault/pack.js` | Pipeline tar → gzip → encrypt → split into volumes → atomic write

; manifest; in-package `RESTORE/` document generation; staging cleanup |
| `vault/policy.js` | GFS r

etention plus size cap plus **incremental-chain protection** plus `_trash` |
| `vault/portable-resto

re.mjs` | The self-contained restorer shipped inside each package |
| `vault/toolkit.js` | Tool-defi

nition builder plus `normalizeParameters` (schema-compliant normalisation) |
| `server.js` | Host HT
TP API (8 endpoints, job tracking, a `confirm` gate; write operations dry-run by default) — **verifi

ed in a real injected session** |
| `client.js` | Five-tab panel in plain DOM — **verified in a real
injected session** |
## 9. Known limitations (an honest list)
1. **Not built**: S3-compatible object storage and cloud-drive CLIs (BaiduPCS-Go). The interface is

shaped as "plug in
one adapter".
2. **Not built**: a queue and a concurrency cap for backup jobs; sc

heduled backups currently run serially.
3. `EXCLUDED_CAP = 2000`: at most 2000 exclusion records per

partition (totals are always reported; the detail list is
truncated).
4. Windows is the main target

; `restore.ps1` needs pwsh, while the rest of the scripts are cross-platform (path
separators are ha

ndled).
5. Restoring the `03-hindsight` partition needs Docker on the target machine for `pg_restore

`; the plain directory part
(`~/.hindsight`) does not.
